facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The first ghost came. It showed Scrooge his past. He was lonely as a boy. Three ghosts came.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The Ghost of Christmas Past appeared at one o'clock that night. It took Scrooge flying through the air to see his own past. He saw himself as a lonely boy sitting alone at school. Three ghosts came to show Scrooge the truth about his life. He also saw how he lost the woman he loved because of greed. Tears rolled down Scrooge's old wrinkled cheeks for the first time.
